summary: This Form 6-K reports the results of an extraordinary general meeting of Zeta Network Group. Shareholders approved a share capital reduction (reducing par value from US$0.25 to US$0.0025 per share), a subdivision of authorized but unissued shares, and a cancellation of excess authorized shares to fix total authorized capital at US$320,000. The filing is a routine corporate housekeeping matter involving a Cayman-issuer reorganization of authorized share structure. It is not a special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or strategic review is involved. The only action is an internal capital restructuring to eliminate accumulated losses and adjust share count for administrative purposes. No deal terms, premium, or board advisor is named. Watch for potential future capital actions; the filing has no risk arbitrage or event-driven implications.
